title: Understanding Transformations
text: When you see a non-linear relationship, applying transformations can help linearize it. Consider transformations like log, square root, or reciprocal to see if they make the relationship more linear.

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: Applying a logarithmic transformation to the dependent variable (Colonies) can sometimes linearize an exponential decay relationship. Think about how $$\ln\left(Y\right)$$ might affect the spread of data points.
